1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.GlobalCutTreeKites
2 
3 /-! The geometric separation property used to assemble an injective star map.
4 It is proved for universal sources in `UniversalStarKiteSeparation`; the
5 gluing and inverse-chart arguments can use the property independently. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.CutTreeCharts
8 
9 open Set
10 
11 /-- Distinct tree-edge kites do not meet each other's interiors. -/
12 def KitesSeparated {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body}
13     {T : P.CutLocusTree a} (charts : CutTreeCharts T) : Prop :=
14   ∀ {u v w z : T.vertices} (first : T.graph.Adj u v) (last : T.graph.Adj w z),
15     s(u, v) ≠ s(w, z) → Disjoint (charts.kite first) (interior (charts.kite last))
16 
17 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.CutTreeCharts
